name: Your Name
intro: AI engineer. I build systems that reason, see and act — from retrieval agents to on-device models.
outro: That’s the tour. Let’s build something that thinks.
about: I care about AI that survives contact with real users. That means careful evaluation, fast feedback loops and interfaces that make a model’s reasoning legible. I work across research, backend and front end, and I ship.

projects.t: A research agent that cites its sources
projects.d: Reads thousands of pages, plans its own searches and answers with line-level citations.
r: 94.2% citation precision across 12,000 multi-hop enterprise queries.
3.4× faster synthesis pipeline via speculative parallel sub-graph retrieval.
Adopted daily by 450+ analysts with zero hallucinated source links.

projects.t: Voice and vision for field technicians
projects.d: A real-time multimodal assistant that sees the equipment and talks the technician through the fix.
r: 38% reduction in mean time-to-repair across 1,800 field dispatches.
Sub-320ms voice-to-voice + frame grounding latency over WebRTC.
Hands-free schematic overlay adopted across 14 regional service teams.

projects.t: A small model that runs on your phone
projects.d: A fine-tuned, quantised language model that summarises on-device with no network.
r: 1.8B LoRA-tuned model matching 7B baseline ROUGE-L within 1.2 points.
48 tokens/sec sustained on mobile NPU with 4-bit GGUF quantization.
Under 1.1 GB peak RAM footprint and <2% battery draw per 50 summaries.

projects.d: A test harness that scores every prompt and model change before it reaches users.
r: Caught 97% of prompt & tool-call regressions in CI prior to staging.
14,000+ golden traces evaluated automatically in under 90 seconds.
Saved ~11 engineering hours per release cycle across 6 product squads.
